findings.title: Failed USE keyspace permanently empties pool instead of keeping connection
findings.claim: A failed USE now drops the new connection instead of adding it to the pool, and current_keyspace is set before USE runs and never cleared on failure, so one bad use_keyspace call or a dropped keyspace causes every refill to fail USE and drain the pool to empty, marking the node Broken/unreachable.

findings.title: Shard-full discard path leaks the total-connections metric
findings.claim: When a shard-aware connection lands on a shard that is already full, the Connection is dropped without calling dec_total_connections(), even though it was counted on open, causing the gauge to leak upward especially behind NAT.
